name: Kandinsky 6 Lite AV
summary: Aperçu vidéo + son de 1,04 seconde, 448×256, 10 étapes. Générations longues non qualifiées.

source.template: Kandinsky 6.0 Text to Video+Audio official 21-node GUI, sampled into 12-node API graph
source.notes: Pin kandinskylab/kandinsky-6@73b892b730885e02ab58fbf7fc5cb10b78e1e3da (comfyui/ subdirectory). Official 3B BF16 K6 model. Cloud9 validation 03b with native VAEDecodeTiled spatial256 temporal16/4, 25f 448x256, audio; GPU time 298.57s and host memory available minimum 12.39GiB. Actual Freefield CLI to be qualified separately; no claim of 5s, no uncensored guarantee. Vision projector must be named mmproj-Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct-BF16.gguf and audio BigVGAN directory preserved, not flattened by generic pack installer.

inputs.label: Scène vidéo
inputs.default: A natural cinematic shot of a clear mountain stream flowing over smooth rocks in daylight. Rippling water moves continuously; leaves and grasses gently sway in the breeze. A locked-off camera, realistic lighting, a single uncut shot.

inputs.label: Ambiance sonore
inputs.default: Gentle flowing water and soft wind rustling through nearby leaves, subtle distant birds.

inputs.label: Éléments à éviter
inputs.default: Static, still frame, 2D cartoon, text, blur, unnatural motion, flicker, deformed objects, low quality.

test.prompt: A natural cinematic shot of a clear mountain stream flowing over smooth rocks in daylight. Rippling water moves continuously; leaves and grasses gently sway in the breeze. A locked-off camera, realistic lighting, a single uncut shot.
test.sound: Gentle flowing water and soft wind rustling through nearby leaves, subtle distant birds.
test.negative: Static, still frame, 2D cartoon, text, blur, unnatural motion, flicker, deformed objects, low quality.

notes: Prévisualisation Cloud9 testée 25 images/24 ips, sans autre durée ou format exposé. Version opt-in séparée des apps Wan/H3/LTX. Le modèle vidéo n’est pas garanti uncensored. La qualité du rendu se juge dans Bibliothèque.
